manual_demonstration.operator_goal: Preserve the Sanko child-school publication-lag case where an exact school URL exposes only old-year confirmation forms.
steps: Start from the exact school URL registered as https://www.sanko.ac.jp/tokyo-child/.
Follow the same-domain disclosure page https://www.sanko.ac.jp/disclosure/tokyo-child/ before SERP fallback.
Observe that the latest target-form candidate is yoshiki2025.pdf with anchor text 2025年度 高等教育の修学支援新制度 申請様式.
Reject the PDF from strict FY2026 success as fiscal_year_mismatch:2025.
Keep the school in publication-lag/operator-reviewable status instead of treating the corporation root as non-target-only evidence.

reusable_rules: Treat 2025年度/yoshiki2025.pdf as latest-public target-form evidence, not as FY2026 success.
Prefer exact school-domain overrides over the Sanko corporation root when both are registered.
Keep the stale target-form evidence visible for operator publication-lag review instead of downgrading the school to non-target-only.
anti_patterns: Do not infer FY2026 from the current system target year when the actual link says 2025年度.
Do not accept stale forms just to improve the strict auto-yield metric.
Do not treat the Sanko corporation root as sufficient when an exact child-school URL exists.

evidence.notes: v517 targeted school ID 55 smoke crawled the exact Tokyo child-school URL, found the latest public yoshiki2025.pdf target form, and rejected it as fiscal_year_mismatch:2025 for target FY2026.
